Here, we describe a woman with stifflimb syndrome who initially presented with concerns about
right foot swelling and pain.

She presented with an 8month
history of right ankle stiffness and described periodic spasms of knee extension and ankle plantar flexion that could be triggered by
sudden noise or movement.

Episodic spasms that were precipitated
by sudden noise or movement and recurrent falls were important
historical details because these are cardinal features of SPS.
